تخابرت (form VI)
# تَخَابَرْتُ (taḵābartu) /ta.xaː.bar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
# تَخَابَرْتَ (taḵābarta) /ta.xaː.bar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
# تَخَابَرْتِ (taḵābarti) /ta.xaː.bar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
# تَخَابَرَتْ (taḵābarat) /ta.xaː.ba.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
